Call to Order – Regular Emergency Preparedness Committee Meeting

Opening Ceremonies

2.  Roll Call

Francis

Present via Zoom: Committee Members Justina Garcia and Neal Greene

Absent: Committee Members Roy Francis and Kwan Lee

Also Present: City Manager Fabiola Huerta, Assistant City Manager Rafferty
Wooldridge, and City Clerk Specialist Anna Badillo

4.  Public Comment

At 6:16 p.m. Committee Member Francis joined the meeting via Zoom.

5.  Committee Reports

Consent Calendar

6.  Approval of Minutes – January 20, 2022

Action: Moved (Pespisa), seconded (Francis), and voted 4-0 (Abstain Garcia; Absent
Lee) to approve the January 20, 2022 Regular Public Safety and Emergency
Preparedness Committee meeting.

  -------------------------------- End of Consent Calendar --------------------------------

*Pursuant to AB 361 and City Council Resolution No. 2021-25, this meeting will be a
hybrid meeting in which Committee Members may join virtually.

The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990.
If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the
City Clerk’s office at (562) 694-6302.

Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Public Safety and
Emergency Preparedness Committee after distribution of the agenda packet are available
for public inspection with the City Clerk at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA
90631 during normal business hours.

PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
In conjunction with Federal, State and Los Angeles County public health regulations, the
public may physically attend Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness Committee
meetings. Due to limited designated seating, members of the public will be allowed to
enter on a first come, first served basis. To protect Committee members, members of the
public and staff, face masks are required indoors at City Hall. The City will evaluate the
current circumstances before each meeting to decide if it is safe to change ongoing
COVID-19 safety protocols in place. Members of the public may also go to
www.Lhhcity.org to view the live broadcast of the Public Safety and Emergency
Preparedness Committee meeting.

For public comments, you may submit comments on any agenda item or item not on the
agenda in writing via mail to City of La Habra Heights, ATTN: Public Safety and
Emergency Preparedness Committee, 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA

REGULAR PUBLIC SAFETY AND EMERGENCY PREPAREDNESS  1  MARCH 17, 2022

 90631 or via email to Info@Lhhcity.org. The public may also provide public comments on
any agenda item or item not on the agenda during Item No. 4, PUBLIC COMMENTS, via
phone at (562) 694-6302 Ext. 0. If you would like to provide public comment via telephone,
please begin your call once the Chair calls the meeting to order. Please note that the
Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness Committee is making every effort to follow
the spirit and intent of the Brown Act and other applicable laws regulating the conduct of
public meetings in order to maximize transparency and public access. It would be
appreciated if communications of public comments are provided prior to the
commencement of the meeting.

Each member of the public may speak for a total of five minutes on any action item listed
on the agenda or other matters within the Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness
Committee's purview except with regard to items listed as public hearings. In addition,
each member of the public may also speak during the second Public Comment segment
for no more than one minute concerning matters not on the agenda. To speak in the
Public Comment segment please complete and deliver a speaker's card to the Clerk prior
to the call for public comments. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your
turn to speak. All Public Comments shall be made in accordance with Section 6 and
Section 8 of the City of La Habra Heights Rules of Procedure.

Should you need to provide written documentation, please give the Clerk a minimum
of NINE (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed
to the Committee.
